tiers.name: Federal government
tiers.desc: U.S. agencies with legally mandated statistical programs.

tiers.name: State government
tiers.desc: Official open-data portals run by state governments and agencies.

tiers.name: Cities, counties & regions
tiers.desc: Official open-data portals of cities, counties and regional agencies. Searchable portals are verified weekly.

tiers.name: Universities & research
tiers.desc: University programs and academic research groups that publish their methods.

tiers.name: Industry & companies
tiers.desc: Companies and trade groups. Useful and timely, but they have a business interest; a disclosure travels with every chart.

federal.name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics
Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
federal.note: Redistributes official series from the agencies above; Plainsight cites the original agency.

thirdParty.name: Our World in Data
thirdParty.org: Research publication run by the University of Oxford and the nonprofit Global Change Data Lab
thirdParty.why: Publishes sources, code and methods for every chart; data licensed CC BY.
thirdParty.disclosure: Mostly republishes and harmonizes primary data (UN, World Bank, Global Carbon Project); the original source is named on each dataset.

thirdParty.name: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers
thirdParty.org: Institute for Social Research, University of Michigan
thirdParty.why: Running since 1946 with published questionnaires and methodology; a component of the government's Index of Leading Indicators.
thirdParty.disclosure: A monthly phone/online survey of about 600-1,000 people, so small moves are within the margin of error.

thirdParty.name: Urban Institute Education Data Portal
thirdParty.org: Urban Institute, a nonpartisan research organization
thirdParty.why: Harmonizes federal education data (NCES, IPEDS, Civil Rights Data Collection) into one documented API.
thirdParty.disclosure: Redistributes federal data; values match the underlying federal source.

thirdParty.name: Zillow Research
thirdParty.org: Zillow Group, a real-estate marketplace company
thirdParty.why: Widely cited, updated monthly, with published methodology and free downloads.
thirdParty.disclosure: Zillow is a real-estate company. The Zillow Home Value Index is its own model of typical home values, not actual sale prices.

thirdParty.name: Indeed Hiring Lab
thirdParty.org: Economic research team at Indeed, a job-listing company
thirdParty.why: Daily data, open on GitHub with documented methodology; often leads official job-openings data.
thirdParty.disclosure: Counts postings on Indeed only. It tracks demand for workers, not total job openings or hires.

thirdParty.name: World Bank
thirdParty.org: International financial institution owned by 189 member countries
thirdParty.why: Standardized national statistics with documented sources for every indicator; CC BY 4.0.
thirdParty.disclosure: Figures come from national statistical offices and vary in quality between countries.
